title: Cost center pool blocks usage
summary: Enable a cost center AI credit pool and show usage stopping when the included pool is exhausted and AI credit paid usage is disabled.

steps.title: Open the month with a first draw
steps.description: A week into the billing period Alice consumes 1,100 of the AI Innovation cost center's 3,900 included credits.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost center included pool, leaving 2,800 credits.

steps.title: Continue drawing down the pool
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost center included pool, leaving 1,900 credits.

steps.title: Pass the halfway mark
steps.description: A further 1,000 included credits are consumed.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost center included pool, leaving 900 credits.

steps.title: Consume most cost center credits
steps.description: Alice consumes 800 more credits, bringing cost center consumption to 3,800 of 3,900.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost center included pool, leaving 100 credits.

steps.title: Try to exceed the included allowance
steps.description: Alice tries to consume 200 more AI credits after only 100 remain in the cost center pool.
steps.expected: The complete event is blocked because the cost-center included allowance is exhausted and the enterprise AI credit paid usage policy is disabled.
